meta.name: Jazz City
meta.description:
Set in 1971 Calcutta, a jazz club becomes the backdrop for a revolutionary awakening as music intertwines with language, identity and the birth of a nation during a pivotal historical moment.

Returning Series · First aired 18 Mar 2026 · IN · Language: Bengali

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: The Dispensable
videos.overview: In the vibrant yet volatile streets of 1969 Calcutta, a sharp-tongued jazz club owner battles corrupt officials, political unrest, and haunted memories while trying to keep his sanctuary alive amidst the impending storm of a nation's fracture.

videos.title: 21st February
videos.overview: As the Bengali language movement intensifies and refugees flood Calcutta, Jimmy must confront his own prejudices and navigate political unrest to protect his sanctuary and those seeking refuge - while shadowy forces conspire to crush the rising tide of revolution.

videos.title: A Night In Park Street
videos.overview: Beneath the smoky lights of a jazz club, a fundraiser masks a dangerous game where whispers of revolution echo, shadows watch every move, and a secret message could ignite a fire that no one can control.

videos.title: The Post Mortem
videos.overview: In the shadows of a city teetering on the brink of chaos, Jimmy is forced into a deadly race against time to save a community from a lethal epidemic - while unseen enemies close in, threatening not only his life but the fragile hope of a revolution on the edge of explosion.

videos.title: The Homecoming
videos.overview: Jimmy journeys into the fractured heart of a nation torn by war and disease, risking everything to save lives while confronting the ghosts of a shattered past, amid the rising storm of revolution and betrayal.

videos.title: Storm of the Century
videos.overview: Tensions and heartbreak reach a boiling point amid East Pakistan's independence movement. Student activists face brutal repression as they demand justice, while secret agents tighten their grip, tracking every move.

videos.title: The Election
videos.overview: Amidst covert political maneuvering, Pakistani leaders celebrate their strategic moves, while in Dhaka, Mujib  inspires hope despite growing violence. Jimmy grapples with escalating surveillance striving to sustain his network as communication lines falter. The episode depicts the onset of South Asia's most brutal genocide on Bengali students and civilians, Sheela and allies face personal peril and heartbreak. As the struggle intensifies, liberation fighters prepare for decisive revolt.

Jimmy grapples with escalating surveillance striving to sustain his network as communication lines falter. The episode depicts the onset of South Asia's most brutal genocide on Bengali students and civilians, Sheela and allies face personal peril and heartbreak. videos.title: Escape To Calcutta
videos.overview: As Sheela grapples with the loss of allies and escalating danger a mysterious ally, Michael, joins Jimmy in a daring escape through forested tunnels to rescue Sheela, battling Pakistani forces in violent confrontations. The episode closes on Jimmy's painful realization of the cost of resistance.

videos.title: Morning Show
videos.overview: Jimmy unbroken, races against time to expose the brutal atrocities committed by the Pakistani army, using rare film footage that captures the harrowing truth of the genocide. The finale culminates in a high-stakes standoff inside a cinema where truth and danger collide.
